nodes.title: Text (User Prompt)
widgets_values:
A tense, tightly framed confrontation between Chen Qianyu (陈千语) on the left and Perlica (佩丽卡) on the right, from Arknights: Endfield (明日方舟：终末地), retaining their recognizable character designs, hairstyles and outfits. Chen Qianyu faces right, gripping an ancient Chinese imperial jian: a straight, double-edged polished steel sword with an ornate gilded guard, restrained dragon engravings and a ceremonial hilt. Perlica faces left, holding a heavy gasoline-powered chainsaw with both hands, its engine housing beside her right hip and its toothed guide bar thrust diagonally toward the center. The sword rises diagonally from the lower left and the chainsaw bar rises from the lower right; their cutting edges meet in a taut, shallow X between the two characters, visibly pressed together under opposing force. The weapon contact sits below their faces, leaving both expressions clearly visible.

The camera is very close, framing both characters from the waist up in a single compact two-shot. Their outer shoulders nearly touch the left and right image borders, with only a sliver of space above their heads. Both faces, their weapon grips and the point of contact fit within the frame. Their bodies lean slightly toward each other, shoulders rigid, fingers clenched tightly around the handles, eyes locked in a fierce, unwavering stare. A few tiny sparks flare where steel meets the running chain. Hard side lighting picks out the sword edge, chainsaw teeth and tense facial contours, while deep shadows sharpen their expressions. The industrial science-fiction surroundings fall into soft focus behind them. The crowded framing, opposing weapon diagonals and compressed space between their faces convey a volatile stalemate at the instant before either fighter strikes.

widgets_values: 此工作流使用 MOSS 的自然语言 Caption 模式。只返回可直接填入正向提示词的画面描述正文，保留用户指定的人物、站位、武器、构图和氛围。遵循用户指定的输出语言，未指定时用英文。最终结果是自然语言文本，不附加 JSON 封装、文件操作步骤、解释、代码块或工具调用。
